title: 📝 Training ⭐⭐⭐: The Whole Shopping Day (global revision)

questions.prompt: Your cousin plays the guitar and his old one is broken. Which shop does he go to?
questions.explanation: A guitar is an instrument, and instruments are the goods of the music shop. The toy shop sells toys, the jewellery shop sells rings and necklaces, and the butcher's sells meat.

questions.prompt: Complete with the past of the verb to pay: "My father ___ 60 dinars for my new shoes."
questions.explanation: Pay is irregular: in the past it becomes paid, and it keeps that one form for every subject. The spelling payed gives it the regular -ed ending it refuses, while pay and pays are the two present forms.

questions.prompt: Sarra says: "The bill was nine hundred and six dinars." Which price did the shop write on the bill?
questions.explanation: Nine hundred is 900 and the word and joins what is left, here six, so the bill reads 906. The price 960 would be read nine hundred and sixty, 916 would be nine hundred and sixteen, and 9006 is nine thousand and six.

questions.prompt: The shopkeeper asks: "Would you like a bag for your books?" You want one. Which answer is correct?
questions.explanation: The short answer that accepts an offer is Yes, please. The answer No, thank you politely refuses, which is the opposite of what you want, and Yes, I am and Yes, I like copy the shape of other questions: Would you like has its own two fixed answers.

questions.prompt: Complete: "Yesterday my sister ___ on five sweaters and she ___ the red one." (to try / to choose)
questions.explanation: Try is regular but ends in a consonant plus -y, so the y becomes i before the ending: tried. Choose is irregular and changes shape instead of taking -ed: chose. The spellings tryed and choosed both apply a rule to a verb that does not follow it.

questions.prompt: Read: "The new mall opened five weeks ago. It has a toy shop, a clothes shop and a big bakery. The clothes shop is in the corner, near the stairs. Last Sunday Amine spent two hundred dinars there and won a prize." Which sentence is true?

options.text: Amine sold a prize at the mall for 200 dinars.
Amine spent 200 dinars at the mall and won a prize.
The bakery is in the corner, near the stairs.
The new mall has no toy shop.

questions.explanation: The text says Amine spent two hundred dinars, that is 200, and that he won a prize, so that sentence is the true one. The corner near the stairs belongs to the clothes shop and not to the bakery, the toy shop is named in the mall's own list of shops, and Amine won his prize, he did not sell it.
